name: spatial-style-ts
description: Style v0's ONE TypeScript reader/resolver (ADR-017 §5a; ADR-022 point 2: 'document semantics stay in renderer/, in exactly two implementations -- one Rust, one TypeScript'). renderer/bundle-viewer and frontends/shell both import these sources directly -- no build step of its own; each consumer's own bundler (esbuild for bundle-viewer, Vite for the shell) compiles this in. Pinned against renderer/tests/data/style-agreement.json, which this package does not generate.
